en: A vintage, sepia-tone postcard showing a large multi-storey institutional building in a landscaped setting. The façade has arched windows on the ground floor, rectangular windows above, and gabled roof sections; one gable has a bird perched on top. Trees and a curved driveway or path appear in the foreground. The caption at the bottom identifies the location and the institution in Hungarian. The reverse side is blank apart from standard postcard dividing lines, a printer's mark, and Hungarian text indicating all rights reserved.
